youtube.title: Who Really Lost the British Accent After 1776?
youtube.description:
In 1776 most Londoners still said their R's, just like most Americans do today. So who really lost the British accent? Not the colonists. The R-dropping 'posh' sound spread through London's elite after America left, then Victorian boarding schools and the BBC carried it across Britain, while Americans kept the older R, plus words like 'gotten' and 'fall'. The Hidden Why tells the true story behind the everyday things you see and use. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
